runtime_observation.default_card_false_branch: The runtime adds the no-card wire flag only when options.defaultCard is explicitly false.
runtime_observation.no_options_branch: With no options, the runtime sends only organisation_did and name and does not add the no-card flag.
runtime_observation.createOrganisation: The runtime dispatches the organization creation contract and returns the newly created DID; this repair does not call it.

type_observation.create_agent_contract: Atomic provisioning writes the agent registry owner/publish-consent link and, unless defaultCard is false, hosts a private default card.
type_observation.agent_uri: Optional; a T3N-hosted card does not require an external agent URI.
type_observation.whoami_owner: The 5.2.0 type documentation says owner is null for agents created without a hosted card or agent URI because they have no registry record.

cli_observation.default: Omitting both --card and --no-card uses the private default-card path.

classification: The original provisioning call explicitly selected the no-card behavior, so it was the wrong path for an organization-owned agent that must have a private hosted card. The resulting missing registry/ownership visibility is consistent with the SDK 5.2.0 documented no-card behavior. The broader createAgent type comment and the whoami owner comment are internally inconsistent about registry persistence; this is recorded as a documentation inconsistency, not treated as proof of an independent platform bug.
repair_policy: Provision exactly one replacement with createAgent(existingOrganisationDid, BreakGlass Agent) and no options.
